usage: music-tagger mb search [-h] --artist ARTIST --album ALBUM
                              [--format FORMAT] [--limit LIMIT] [-o OUT]

Search MusicBrainz for candidate releases.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --artist ARTIST  Artist name.
  --album ALBUM    Album title.
  --format FORMAT  Media format filter (default: CD).
  --limit LIMIT    Max results (default: 10).
  -o, --out OUT    Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
